QuestInfo.name: A Promise Between Three Friends
QuestInfo.0: #p218# over at #m10001050# seems to have something she wants to tell #p204#.
QuestInfo.1: When I met #p218# at #m10001050#, it turned out she was just a girl who wasn't very good at being honest about her feelings. Too embarrassed, or something like that. Still, somehow I think I understand how she feels. #p218# asked me to go tell #b#p204##k that the two of them should visit #p225#'s farm together sometime. Those two are pretty cute, aren't they? \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I passed along #p218#'s suggestion to #p204# at #m10001000#. I'm already curious to see what's in store for the three of them — #p204#, #p218#, and #p225#.

0.0: #p204#, you idiot... Why would you go this far for me? I wanted to prank her and it's not fun at all...! #p204#'s always like this. Just hopelessly kind to a fault. But still, this #b#t4031121##k really is pretty.
0.1: Honestly, I wish I could be as honest about my feelings as #p204# is. But that kind of thing is just so embarrassing, and I'm no good at it, what can I do. Anyway, I'll treasure this gift. My dear friend made it just for me, after all. So, I was wondering... could you go tell #p204# something for me?

yes.0: Thanks! Tell #p204# that I said we should go visit #p225#'s farm together sometime. The #o10#s on the farm are a bit fierce, but hey, I've done a bit of studying up on magic myself, so I'm sure it'll be fine. And I'll brag to #p225# that my marble is prettier. I'm counting on you!

no.0: Turning me down now, of all times...?

1.0: Oh, you're back! Hm? #p218# liked my present? Oh, I'm so relieved. I just knew she'd like it~ hehe...
1.1: And she said we should go visit #p225#'s farm together sometime? I've always wanted to go, but the #o10#s on the farm are so fierce that I never even considered it, so... are you saying #p218# really, truly asked to come along with me?
1.2: I'm so happy! If I'm going with #p218#, I'm sure everything will be fine. Come to think of it, I can't even remember the last time the three of us got to play together. Ahh~ I'm already looking forward to that day. I wonder what kind of lunch I should pack... Oh! Anyway, thank you so much for all your help this whole time. I look forward to being your neighbor from here on out too!

npc.0: You have to tell #p204# that I said we should go visit #p225#'s farm together sometime. Got it?
